verdict.rationale: Slack ships Slackbot, which it describes as a built-in personal AI agent. Per the vendor, it can prepare for meetings, analyze reports, create project briefs, update deals on request, research open-ended questions in a full-screen workspace, and route requests to other agents. Built-in AI also summarizes channels and threads and takes huddle notes. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which actions Slackbot can actually carry out and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing copy).
